field: International humanitarian law and human rights
qualifications: Law degree that allows the holder to sit the bar examination in their country of origin or residence; final-year students may apply if the diploma is obtained by June
Two recommendation letters (one academic, one professional)
Scholarship track restricted to citizens of non-western countries; applicants choose either the scholarship or the regular track
description_short: The Geneva Academy's LLM in International Humanitarian Law and Human Rights admits students for the September 2027 intake. Applications open on 17 November 2026; the scholarship-track deadline is 17 January 2027 and the regular deadline 17 February 2027, with rolling review.
